'''Battle Station Operations''' was a branch of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] devoted to siege equipment, mainly space stations (such as [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan Space Defense SpaceGuns]] and [[Death Star/Legends|Death Stars]]). It was headed by [[Battle Station Command/Legends|Battle Station Command]].

==History==
[[File:Deathstar-command.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Battle Station Operations place in the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] command organization.]]
Battle Station Operations was one of the three leading branches aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] (along with army and navy operations).<ref name="DSTC">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref> [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] acted as the head of Battle Station Operations,<ref name="DSTC" /> with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]] serving as the operations chief before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Aboard the first Death Star, Battle Station Operations comprised eight departments (each under the command of one major): logistics, personnel, security, station defenses, engineering, medical, technical support and maintenance-repair.<ref name="DSTC" />

[[Titus Klev]] was assigned to Battle Station Operations, but he never served aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] as it was destroyed at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. He later served in some [[Siege platform/Legends|Dedicated Siege Platforms]] and orbital bases, eventually rising through the ranks of [[Battle Station Command/Legends|Battle Station Command]].<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
